items.title: 'How do you explain that?' The rare, complex case of PNG's conjoined twins
items.description: A team of doctors involved in the separation of conjoined Papua New Guinean twins Sawong and Tom have spoken for the first time about the rare and complex case.

items.title: Israel undermines support as it focuses on optics over actions
items.description: In the wake of an outcry over its treatment of detained activists, Israel has focused on messaging as its actions undermine its support from the international community.

items.title: ASIO warning before Bondi attack did not single out elevated Hanukkah risk
items.description: Australia's intelligence agency, ASIO, issued its annual holiday threat assessment less than two weeks before the Hanukkah terrorist attack at Bondi Beach but did not identify heightened risks to the Jewish festival, despite earlier declaring antisemitism as its top priority in terms of threat to life.

items.title: Do the kids reckon this budget created any winners?
items.description: As debate over the federal government's budget tax hit on wealth and assets continues to reverberate, one can't help but wonder how it's going down among the gen Zs and millennials it's designed to impress.

items.title: Tax changes 'threaten to chill' record federal green energy support
items.description: As the federal government races towards its 2030 renewable energy goal, investors warn capital gains taxes changes risk upending the entire effort.

items.title: At a crossroad, Suzie Miller took the risky path, away from a safe job
items.description: In 2009, Suzie Miller had a choice between becoming a magistrate in Australia or a residency at the National Theatre in London.

items.title: Breaking: Tulsi Gabbard resigns as Donald Trump's director of national ​intelligence
items.description: Tulsi Gabbard says she is departing from the role to support her husband after his recent bone cancer diagnosis.

items.title: Sydney Harbour rubbish loads rise during Vivid, Seabin claims
items.description: Data from floating rubbish bins near the Sydney CBD suggests there are higher levels of rubbish entering the water when major events such as Vivid are on.

items.title: 'Life is football' here but without money, Australia's most unique club won't survive
items.description: The Tiwi Islands are unique and Australian Rules football is a way of life that has spawned some of the game's biggest names. But even as favourite son Willie Rioli Jr returns home, the Tiwi Bombers know they need more help.

items.title: 'We adored him': Family's heartfelt tribute after Australian's Inca Trail death
items.description: Australian man Matthew Paton, a Victoria Police sergeant, has died in Peru after falling up to 400 metres from a mountain path while walking the Inca Trail to Machu Picchu.

items.title: IS-linked families arrive in Damascus ahead of journey to Australia
items.description: After leaving the al-Roj refugee camp on Thursday, a group of seven Australian women and 14 children has arrived in the Syrian capital, Damascus.

items.title: A community college had AI read out graduate names. It didn't go well
items.description: It's graduation season for universities across the US, which has bred an unexpected viral trend: graduates jeering at artificial intelligence.

items.title: Fracking could open the door to 10 years of gas supply but is there a risk?
items.description: A decade's worth of gas supply for South Australia is potentially sitting below the Limestone Coast region. But will it ever be extracted?

items.title: How a 3,400yo ball game survives in Mexico against all odds
items.description: Ulama remains an important part of Mexican identity, with authorities leveraging the momentum of the FIFA World Cup to shine a spotlight on the ancient sport once again.

items.title: The prickly plant powering a new spirits industry
items.description: Australia's emerging agave industry is attracting interest from distillers, farmers and scientists who believe the spiky plant could transform everything from tequila production to sustainable aviation fuel.

items.title: ABC 50/50 quiz: Test your knowledge of Prince, Twin Peaks and some very important donkeys
items.description: Each question in the ABC 50/50 quiz has only two options: one is right; the other is wrong. But there's a catch.

items.title: 'Live-streamed genocide': Palestinian poet writes from Gaza's frontline
items.description: The month he turned 30, Mosab Abu Toha was blindfolded, beaten and detained by the Israel Defense Forces. The essay he wrote about it won a Pulitzer Prize.

items.title: 'Arc de Trump' is one step closer to being built. Here's why it's controversial
items.description: The Arc de Triomphe-inspired arch in Washington DC is meant to commemorate the US's 250th anniversary but its location is causing controversy.

items.title: Putin says at least six people killed in 'terrorist' attack on student dormitory
items.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin has accused Ukraine of a "terrorist strike" on a student dormitory in the Russian-controlled Luhansk region that has killed at least six people and injured 39 others.

items.title: Labor leaves door open to an additional trust tax exemption
items.description: The federal government has left the door open to further changes after coming under pressure for including future discretionary testamentary trusts in a new tax announced in the budget.

items.title: Pacific leaders warned of 'prolonged' fuel crisis as new plan endorsed
items.description: A taskforce will see leaders get a better idea of threats to energy deliveries, while Australia and New Zealand provide expert analysis on future supply.

items.title: Stephen Colbert wraps up Late Show with Paul McCartney and a fake pope
items.description: While Colbert's CBS network came in for plenty of jibes over the course of the episode, it was a largely apolitical affair, with attacks on US President Donald Trump ditched in favour of joy, jokes and songs.

items.title: Inside this town, 'it's not a secret' that half the people don't officially exist
items.description: In a community like no other, what happens when people aren't counted? Welcome to the supposedly small country town with hidden houses and five Asian supermarkets.

items.title: Freo notches 10th straight win with Saints triumph, Tigers down Bombers
items.description: Fremantle makes club history with a 30-point victory over St Kilda, as Essendon loses three key players to injury in an 18-point loss to Richmond.

items.title: Storm 'steamrolled' as the Bulldogs coach slams 'outside noise' after snapping horror losing streak
items.description: Matt Burton has inspired inspired the Canterbury Bankstown Bulldogs to a 30-20 come-from-behind victory against the Melbourne Storm, snapping their five-game losing streak.
